sources.evidence: Page 'University of Lethbridge 2020 Teams' lists three U of L teams and their ranks (4, 24, 29 of 33) in the Rocky Mountain Regional, with links to ACPC/RMC/NADC Kattis scoreboards; it is not a standings page of a Lethbridge contest.
Kattis problem list of 'Alberta Collegiate Programming Contest 2020 - Division 1' (acpc20d1, 10 problems A-J, 2020-11-14), a different contest from a Lethbridge Collegiate Programming Contest.

notes: Neither source is a Lethbridge Collegiate Programming Contest 2020 document; Lethbridge teams competed in ACPC 2020 (Nov 14, 2020), RMC 2020 and NADC 2021. Consistent with the catalogue note that the contest was probably not held. The s1 page may be a source for ACPC/RMC results of the U of L teams only.
